title: Mysterious Creature Encountered by Chilean Fishermen
excerpt: Chilean fishermen encounter a mysterious creature, reviving an ancient legend about a terrifying being believed to inhabit local waters.
content:
Two fishermen in Chile captured a strange creature lurking beneath the surface of an unnamed river. Its unusual shape has attracted attention online, with viewers comparing the mysterious animal to a legendary monster from South American folklore. What makes this encounter particularly intriguing is its resemblance to a giant stingray, though its appearance seems quite unlike familiar freshwater species.

The creature has a broad, flattened body with rounded contours. In the footage, it looks strikingly like a large piece of animal skin moving through the water. Local freshwater stingrays are reportedly at least half its size, making the apparent size of the unidentified animal particularly intriguing.

Fishermen managed to capture the strange form on camera, providing a brief glimpse of something they apparently didn’t recognize. The Clinic reports this.

The footage quickly gained attention and drew comparisons to El Cuero, a fearsome creature from the mythology of Chile’s indigenous communities. It is also known as Trelque Wekufe and Canillo, among several other regional names. These names are commonly associated with an evil spirit or demonic skin. According to traditional descriptions, the creature resembles a huge, flattened piece of skin floating underwater.

https://ua-stena.info/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/fishermen.mp4

Legends describe El Cuero as a creature with sharp claws or spines along the edges of its body. Its underside is believed to contain a mouth and powerful suction organs used to capture prey.

The creature is said to attack animals and people approaching the water, suddenly leaping out and wrapping its body around them. Once attached, it supposedly suffocates its victims before devouring them.

When the fishermen’s video appeared on social media, many viewers immediately noticed the resemblance. Commenters reportedly speculated that the strange shape could be the mythical El Cuero himself. This comparison brought renewed attention to the legend, which has been passed down through generations in local lore.

The legendary El Cuero, a mysterious creature from Chilean folklore, is said to lurk beneath the waters of rivers and lakes. Video in Spanish.

However, the unusual appearance also gave rise to several alternative explanations. One possibility is that a large stingray somehow ended up in a freshwater river. Another suggests an unusually large specimen of a local species of freshwater stingray. However, one detail makes these explanations less certain: no tail is visible in the video, despite the long tail characteristic of local freshwater stingrays.

Some viewers have speculated that the creature may not be an animal at all. The dense mass of underwater vegetation could potentially create such a strange silhouette. Nevertheless, the video has left much room for speculation.

At this time, the identity of the mysterious creature the fishermen saw remains unknown. Whether it was an unusual aquatic animal, a cluster of vegetation, or something reminiscent of the legendary El Cuero, the fishermen’s discovery certainly revived a troubling question: what else might lurk beneath the surface of Chile’s rivers?

It was previously reported that fishermen had recovered a mysterious creature from the bottom of the Mariana Trench, which astonished them with its enigmatic appearance. This little-explored region of the Pacific Ocean continues to amaze scientists.
